|errata_history=This is the original printed text. The later errata version is [[Clone Pilot (Virtual Block 5) (Errata)]] (PC-E1, the current text). The images here (the Virtual Block 5 release-sheet slip and the Players Committee card image) show this text; the PC-E1 text is shown by a CardMaker recreation on [[Clone Pilot (Virtual Block 5) (Errata)]].
* '''Original''' (this page): text as given in the Virtual Block 5 release sheet (official text as of 7 December 2009): “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting a [Republic] starship at a battleground, forfeit +1 and your Force drains are +1 here. Anything he pilots is manuever +1 and immune to attrition < 3 (< 5 if all your pilot characters here are clones and/or Jedi).”.<ref name="sheet-VirtualBlock5">[https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Virtual Block 5 release sheet] ("Official text as of 7 December 2009"). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20261027095234/https://res.starwarsccg.org/legacyblocks/VirtualBlock5.pdf Internet Archive]</ref> The slip prints the pilot icon followed by “2.”; the wiki writes it “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots.”, as the card list does. The Master List (official text as of 27 April 2013) prints this text again. That copy is a stale reprint, not a new version, because the PC website card list already showed the later text of [[Clone Pilot (Virtual Block 5) (Errata)]] (wiki versions ruling, 8 November 2026).<ref name="ml-ls">[[Media:Virtual_Legacy_Final_Master_LS.pdf|Players Committee Virtual Cards Master List (Light Side)]], cover "official text as of April 27, 2013" (PDF built February 2014). Original: http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf. Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20170705013057/http://www.starwarsccg.org/Resources/MasterLS.pdf Internet Archive]</ref>
* '''PC-E1''' ([[Clone Pilot (Virtual Block 5) (Errata)]]): The PC website card list (shown there by 21 July 2012, the earliest archived capture with text, and in every capture to 11 January 2013) corrected the printed typo “manuever” to “maneuver”. PC-E1 text: “Adds 2 to power of anything he pilots. While piloting a [Republic] starship at a battleground, forfeit +1 and your Force drains are +1 here. Anything he pilots is maneuver +1 and immune to attrition < 3 (< 5 if all your pilot characters here are clones and/or Jedi).”<ref name="cl-1250_35-2012-07-21">Players Committee website card list (VBlock5Type), as captured [https://web.archive.org/web/20120721064732/http://www.starwarsccg.org:80/cardlists/VBlock5Type.html 2012-07-21] (Internet Archive)</ref>
